findings.text: follow-on: the two arms are invoked on slightly different commands -- the base arm carries `-p no:cacheprovider` and the head arm drops it, and neither the gate.txt nor the head crossing carries a `module.__file__` line at the head revision (only the base extraction names one). Neither changes the measured result (5 vs 6 passed, zero added failures, both EXIT=0), but a reader comparing arm headers cannot tell the two runs used the same pytest isolation.

follow-on: the node declared docs/figures/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner/a-superseded-producer-ends in its write scope but wrote no figure. The supersede sequence (unlink -> replacement takes the path -> superseded wakes and ends) is a sequential relationship the figure mandate says to show, but the node's done-when names no figure and the plan explicitly withholds a test drive from a test node.

item_verdicts.diff: read recover.py: the only production change is joining the _recreate_unlinked_registration signature from three wrapped lines to one so ruff format --check reports 5 hunks (was 6 at df6a40b5c), matching the settled 2c49c0457 count; the superseded branch itself (returning the inode comparison, False when the path holds another inode) already existed and is what the new test drives.
item_verdicts.done_when: the new case is in the named file and runs at head 3 passed/EXIT=0 in my own invocation; the negative control (superseded branch returns True) reddens exactly this node's new id, 1 failed/EXIT=1, and the head arm does not fail it.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a test drives the superseded-producer branch of the unlinked-seat recreation; tests/test_producer_registration_survives_unlink.py::test_a_superseded_producer_ends_without_overwriting_the_replacement unlinks the seat under a sleeping producer, starts a replacement that takes the vacated path, and asserts the first producer ends on its next wake-up, the record still names the replacement, and crew unwatch stops the producer that now holds the seat.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it names commits f171024ed and 0b109d9fb, the head gate (3 passed), the arms (base 5 passed vs head 6 passed, zero added), the negative-control log, and baseline_suite/after_suite both completed with failure_count 0; its evidence_inputs and artifact figures all resolve to real logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff df6a40b5c..0b109d9fb touches exactly four paths, all inside the declared scope: tests/test_producer_registration_survives_unlink.py (108 +/-), reckon/crew/recovery.py (signature join, 2 replaced lines), and the two evidence fragments; the declared figure directory is unused and no out-of-scope file is touched.

justifications.durability: the guarded thing is made to happen and the refusal shown: the head arm passes the new case, and making the superseded branch return True (my own run of the declared mutation) turns it red on its own assertion -- 'the superseded producer outlived the replacement that took its seat' -- so the test measures the branch rather than a tautology, and watch_ticker returns on that False.
justifications.evidence: the gate reproduces at head (3 passed, EXIT=0); I reproduced the negative control in an independent scratch extraction, 1 failed/EXIT=1 on test_a_superseded_producer_ends_without_overwriting_the_replacement; ruff check on recovery.py is 9 findings at head, equal to base 60b808f5f's 9; ruff format --check is 5 hunks, equal to 2c49c0457's 5 and one fewer than this node's own base df6a40b5c's 6; and the corrected registration-survives-an-unlink fragment reading (2 failed/25 passed in 83.97 s) matches that predecessor run's own logs/base-arm.txt verbatim. One arm-header inconsistency noted under follow-ons.
justifications.fit: the case reuses the file's driver/stub pattern, spawns a real separate-session producer because unwatch signals the recorded pid's process group, and documents why the superseded producer is armed at 8.0 s (80x the replacement's 0.1 s poll) so the case measures takeover rather than which process wins a race; the production change is a formatting join whose rationale is a review finding, not a behaviour change.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the branch that ends a producer whose seat a replacement has taken -- recorded by the registration-survives-an-unlink review as untested (its third finding) -- is now driven end to end: the test observes the takeover, the first producer's exit, the replacement record surviving, and unwatch finding and stopping the replacement, which is the exact behaviour the function's docstring claims.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat df6a40b5c..0b109d9fb is four paths, every one inside the declared write scope; the production edit is the declared signature join and nothing else; no test, index, sprint or plan state is touched outside scope.
